shard_rows_randomly: create a RandomSharder to split training data randomly across a specified number of shards
shard_rows_sequentially: build a SequentialSharder to assign consecutive rows to shards with a fixed examples per shard count
shard_rows_broadcast: create a BroadcastSharder to copy each training datum to all shards for uniform distribution
shard_rows_by_column: build a ColumnSharder to partition data rows into shards based on a specified column value
shard_rows_round_robin: create a RoundRobinSharder to split training data in a round-robin fashion across all shards
